helpSupport.title: Help and support
helpSupport.subtitle: How can we help you?
helpSupport.suggestionsHelpDesc: Share your opinion to improve the app

helpSupport.sendMessageDesc: If you didn't find what you were looking for, write to us directly
helpSupport.messageSentDesc: Thank you for contacting us. We will respond shortly.
helpSupport.faq1q: How can I add a place to favorites?
helpSupport.faq1a: To add a place to favorites, simply tap the heart icon in the upper right corner of the business page. The place will appear in your "My favorites" section.
helpSupport.faq2q: How do I write a review?
helpSupport.faq2a: Go to the business page, scroll down to the reviews section and press the "Write a review" button. Select your rating, write your comment and optionally add photos.
helpSupport.faq3q: Can I edit or delete my review?
helpSupport.faq3a: Yes, go to your profile > My reviews. Tap the three dots on your review and select "Edit" or "Delete".
helpSupport.faq4q: How do I change my profile picture?
helpSupport.faq4a: Go to your profile, tap your current photo and select "Change photo". You can take a new photo or choose one from your gallery.
helpSupport.faq5q: How do I turn off notifications?
helpSupport.faq5a: Go to your profile > Settings > Notifications. From there you can customize what type of notifications you want to receive.
helpSupport.faq6q: Can businesses respond to my reviews?
helpSupport.faq6a: Yes, business owners can respond to reviews. You will receive a notification when they respond to your review.
helpSupport.faq7q: How do I report inappropriate content?
helpSupport.faq7a: You can report reviews or inappropriate content by tapping the three-dot icon and selecting "Report". Our team will review the report.
helpSupport.faq8a: Yes, go to Profile > Settings > Privacy and security > Delete my account. Please note that this action is permanent.
